title: First-principles investigation of the optical and piezoelectric properties of Janus TiOS monolayers
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,49652-49660

The 1T- and 2H-TiOS monolayers possess intrinsic electric fields, strong redox driving forces, and high piezoelectric coefficients, enabling efficient combined photocatalytic and piezoelectric applications.
